title: MIDAS operating packet: connected owner journey and remaining evidence gaps
authorship: Development-assistant synthesis of repository implementation and preserved observations; not an independent founder, customer, financial or expert assessment.
objective: Understand a connected business with explicit uncertainty, prioritize its valuable constraints, assemble the smallest supported team, improve workers through fair evidence, execute within authority and revise understanding from verified outcomes.
scope: MIDAS is an adaptive business-building system. Support and supplier invoices are bounded acceptance environments, not the product ontology or selected market.
statusNote: Connected offline workbench implemented and browser-exercised. Historical observations are unchanged. New fixtures establish mechanics only; no new provider execution.

bottlenecks.statement: The business-loop value is constrained when business interpretations and candidate actions must be authored before the system can plan.
bottlenecks.uncertainty: No customer research or quantified business impact establishes the priority; this is an engineering dependency judgment.
bottlenecks.work: Connect permitted evidence to bounded, sourced ModelPort proposals for claims, conflicts, unknowns, requests, hypotheses and competencies; owner adopts a revision.
bottlenecks.acceptance: Altered source facts change proposed understanding; invalid references/rights and unsupported estimates fail deterministic checks; proposals never silently become facts.
bottlenecks.dependency: Strict proposal contracts and stage-specific admission.
bottlenecks.currentStatus: Local implementation complete; live model utility and owner usefulness remain unmeasured

bottlenecks.statement: Existing evidence cannot establish when a specialist/team earns added cost or whether delivered work changes business outcomes.

bottlenecks.work: Expose competency evidence and uncertainty, connect observed failures to versioned procedure-only comparison mechanics, and prepare a value-gated live diagnostic of the richer connected path.
